children: No matter where you look in the gold market, the bulls appear to be in charge. "Across positioning, flow, and derivatives data, every signal we track continues to point in the same direction: the market is bullish on gold across all fronts," says Societe Generale. What began as a geopolitical shock has evolved into a broad-based build-up of physical, futures and options bets that span retail investors, professional money managers and derivatives traders, it says. "We are now awaiting August central bank data to confirm whether official-sector demand, a key structural pillar of this bull market, remains as robust as in prior months," says SocGen. Any acceleration or slowdown in central-bank buying could help show how durable the bull run might be, it says. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
